summary: The five strata exhaust the unique-zero cases modulo the two allowed interchanges, and their column-sum equations, negative-mean inequalities, and literal middle-cap formulas are correct. The rank-one perturbation preserves column sums, q, compatibility, nonsingularity, all required centroid-incidence data, and strict row-mass inequalities by upper semicontinuity of the closed cap, including repeated and constant-at-threshold values. Each prescribed perturbation sign produces the stated all-nonzero support pair, every such pair lies outside the contained-support orbit, and accepted fact 89f1aef98e9b8915 therefore applies to yield the required contradiction.
